def setdefault(self, name, default=None, priority="project"):
    """
    Set default value for a setting if not already set.
    """
    if name not in self:
        self.set(name, default, priority)
        return default
    else:
        return self[name]

Note signature may accept priority optionally. Issue suggests adding priority arg may change signature but fine.
